scope: New nonlinear/down owner in actual channel prediction, frame batching, paired gate/up projection and nonlinear activation using all600 compiled memories at the typical corner with UNIT_DELAY. Full5632-channel frames and full2048-input sparse arithmetic are checked. This test does not interleave down work; joint nonlinear/down sharing is checked separately in93. Not a whole-processor, mapped timing, accuracy or paper-energy qualification.
experimental_adapter_source:
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
// One shared five-cluster fabric executes both full gate/up projections.
module tri_oracle_gated_fabric (
    input logic clk,
    input logic rst_n,
    input logic in_valid,
    output logic in_ready,
    input logic in_last,
    input logic in_fallback,
    input logic [31:0] in_tag,
    input logic [2559:0] in_channels,
    input logic [7:0] in_count,
    input logic [63:0] in_activation_base,
    input logic [63:0] in_weight_base,
    input logic [63:0] in_up_weight_base,
    input logic [9:0] in_features,
    input logic [5:0] in_gate_shift,
    input logic [5:0] in_up_shift,
    output logic out_valid,
    input logic out_ready,
    output logic out_last,
    output logic out_fallback,
    output logic out_error,
    output logic [31:0] out_tag,
    output logic [7:0] out_count,
    output logic [2559:0] out_channels,
    output logic [5119:0] out_data,
    output logic req_valid,
    input logic req_ready,
    output logic [63:0] req_address,
    output logic [4:0] req_length,
    input logic rsp_valid,
    input logic rsp_last,
    input logic rsp_error,
    output logic rsp_ready,
    input logic [63:0] rsp_data
);

  tri_oracle_gated_down_fabric owner (
      .in_is_down(1'b0), .in_accumulate(1'b0), .in_data(1024'b0),
      .in_dense_features(17'd5632), .in_output_start(16'b0), .in_output_count(8'b0),
      .in_shift(6'b0), .in_slot(4'b0), .out_is_down(), .out_start(), .out_slot(), .*
  );
endmodule
